story.zh: 数次北伐，蜀汉国力耗损深重。诸多凶兆预示此番出征必将遭遇重挫，诸葛亮为践先帝遗志、依旧倾尽全力，毅然逆天而行。
story.en: After repeated Northern Expeditions, Shu Han's national power was heavily depleted. Though numerous ill omens foretold that this march would suffer grave setbacks, Zhuge Liang still gave his all to fulfill the late Emperor's dying wish, resolutely defying fate.
